cli.welcome.title: Welcome to Zinc {version}: apps, games and boards in TypeScript.
cli.welcome.choose: Type 1 to 5 and press Enter (Enter alone: {default}):
cli.welcome.after: zinc help lists the commands; zinc config set lang changes the language.
cli.help.title: zinc: apps, games and boards in typed TypeScript
cli.help.more: More: zinc help --all lists every command; zinc help <command> describes one.
cli.help.project: In a project folder, zinc run, zinc build and zinc check need no argument.
cli.help.options: With any command: -v shows the steps and their durations (-vv more), -q hides them, --lang en|fr|es|it|de chooses the language, --background opens windows without taking the focus, --log-format json prints one JSON object per line.
cli.help.log: ZINC_LOG=<module>=<level>,... chooses what -v shows (modules build, plugin, run, ui; levels info, debug, trace), for example ZINC_LOG=ui=debug for the layout passes.
cli.help.engine: For work on the engine itself: lex, parse, ir, zbc, bake, profile, mem, device-sim, --version, --emit=cpp|zbc.
